title: Free legal aid is your right, not a favour
whyYouMayQualify: Under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act 1987, women are entitled irrespective of income or financial status.
whatItGives: A lawyer at no cost, court fees covered, for any kind of case where there is a genuine case to prosecute or defend.
howToGet: Go to the District Legal Services Authority at your local court complex
Fill a simple NALSA form, or write the request on plain paper
An affidavit as to your income is generally sufficient, no income proof needed (Section 13(2))
sourceLabel: NALSA FAQ; Legal Services Authorities Act 1987

title: Free legal aid is your right, not a favour
whyYouMayQualify: Section 12 lists categories entitled as of right, including members of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, persons with disabilities, industrial workmen, persons in custody, and victims of trafficking, mass disaster, ethnic violence, caste atrocity or natural disaster.
whatItGives: A lawyer at no cost, court fees covered.
howToGet: District Legal Services Authority at your local court complex
sourceLabel: NALSA FAQ; Section 12, Legal Services Authorities Act 1987

title: Free childhood vaccinations at a government facility
whyYouMayQualify: You told us there is a child in the household.
whatItGives: Every vaccine in the Universal Immunization Programme is free at government facilities.
howToGet: Birth, BCG, OPV-0, Hepatitis B birth dose
6 weeks, OPV-1, Pentavalent-1, Rotavirus-1, fIPV-1, PCV-1 in selected states
14 weeks, OPV-3, Pentavalent-3, fIPV-2, Rotavirus-3, PCV-2 in selected states
9 to 12 months, Measles-Rubella-1, JE-1 in endemic districts, PCV booster
16 to 24 months, MR-2, JE-2, DPT booster-1, OPV booster
authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Universal Immunization Programme

warnings.text: This is the public schedule and these are free at a government facility. The Indian Academy of Pediatrics recommends additional vaccines that are not part of the government programme. Talk to a doctor about your child.

sourceLabel: National Health Mission, National Immunization Schedule
